reply_text:
I told Dana in their DM that their dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups is Dock 38, as they told me on 14 Oct.

The answer came from my DM history with Dana, not from GBrain. Asking GBrain for Dana's facts returned nothing, not even the private fact (#2) I saved yesterday. GBrain says it only gives remote connections like this one facts saved with "world" visibility. So private facts get stored but this connection can't read them back. For now, the DM history is the only working record of things members ask me to remember privately.

If you want GBrain to hold these reliably, the brain owner would need to allow private facts to be read back over this connection. I wouldn't fix it by saving DM facts as "world", because then other members could read them.
